triage.headline: Input problem: casing ID differs from the tally
triage.what: Defect Summary shows 19.97% wall loss at joint 57; the client expects 21%

prior_art.what: Wall loss was off because the casing record ID differed from the tally
prior_art.why: Same known cause, but each well's casing record has to be checked on its own

triage.cause: The casing record has ID 4.5 in while the tally has 4.55 in, so nominal thickness is 0.500 in and wall loss computes to 19.97%

evidence.fact: Casing Record row 3 has ID 4.5 in; the tally has 4.55 in

analyst: Set the ID in DVT1234_client_info.xlsm, Casing Record row 3, to 4.55 in and rerun the Defect Summary

triage.reply: Casing Record row 3 in the client info has ID 4.5 in, but the casing tally has 4.55 in. With 4.55 in, wall loss at joint 57 computes to 21.02%.

class.prevent_note: Warn when the casing record ID differs from the tally
